hooks.text: A tiny frozen moon is painting one of Saturn's rings.
The brightest object in the Solar System is shooting its ocean into space.
Why is a tiny frozen moon building one of Saturn's rings?

title: The Moon That Builds Saturn's Rings
description: NASA's Cassini spacecraft uncovered how Saturn's tiny frozen moon Enceladus repaints itself and builds an entire ring.

beats.text: A tiny frozen moon is painting one of Saturn's rings.
beats.visual: Cassini mosaic showing Enceladus embedded within Saturn's E ring, 2006

beats.text: Enceladus is only 310 miles wide, yet it is the most reflective body in the Solar System.
beats.visual: Cassini full-disk natural color mosaic of Enceladus, 2005

beats.text: Because its pristine surface bounces back almost all sunlight, temperatures hover around minus 324 degrees Fahrenheit.
beats.visual: Cassini thermal map overlay of Enceladus, 2005

beats.text: For over two centuries, astronomers had no idea how such a small rock stayed dazzlingly white.
beats.visual: William Herschel's forty-foot telescope sketch at Slough, 1789

beats.text: Then in 2005, the Cassini spacecraft caught giant fractures dubbed tiger stripes erupting near its south pole.
beats.visual: Cassini high-resolution false-color view of tiger stripes on Enceladus, 2005
queries: Enceladus tiger stripes Cassini false color

beats.text: Massive geysers blast water vapor, salts, and organic molecules straight into space.
beats.visual: Cassini backlit image of ice plumes erupting from Enceladus, 2005

beats.text: Measuring the moon's subtle orbital wobble revealed that these jets tap directly into a global liquid ocean.
beats.visual: NASA diagram of Enceladus internal structure and subsurface ocean, 2015

beats.text: Much of this ocean spray falls back as pristine snow, while the rest escapes to build Saturn's E ring.
beats.visual: Cassini wide-angle view of Saturn's E ring illuminated by the Sun, 2006

better_than_last: Replaces slow historical build-up with an immediate contradiction hook and delivers the physical mystery payoff quickly to prevent early swipe-away.
